initiatives.name: LFK Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Lawrence, Kansas mutual aid network formed in 2020 during COVID-19. Coordinates volunteers and has pushed for housing security and homelessness prevention.

initiatives.name: ECM KU Solidarity Library
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run library of over 4,000 radical books plus zines, pamphlets and periodicals, in the ECM building at 1204 Oread Ave, Lawrence. Open Thursdays during Veggie Lunch.

initiatives.name: Lawrence Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Lawrence Food Not Bombs cooks and serves free vegetarian or vegan meals on Sundays in Lawrence, KS. Volunteers source food from local farms and other volunteers.

initiatives.name: Lawrence Tenants
initiatives.description: Tenants organizing to make it easier to rent in Lawrence. We are currently organizing for right to counsel for tenants facing eviction

initiatives.name: Trans Lawrence Coalition
initiatives.description: Trans Lawrence Coalition is a trans-led organization seeking to protect & expand the social and political well-being of trans people in Lawrence, KS.
